function.name: ExpediaSearchReservations
function.description: Search for existing flight or accommodation reservations based on reservation type, query string, start date, and end date. The query string is searched for in the reservation details.

reservation_type.description: The type of reservation, possible values: 'flight', 'accommodation'.

query.description: The query string to search for in the reservation details.

start_date.description: The start date of the reserved flight or accommodation in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date of the reserved flight or accommodation in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5.

function.name: GmailSendEmail
function.description: Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.

to.description: A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.

cc.description: A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.

bcc.description: A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.

send_at.description: The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.

attachments.description: An array of local file paths of attachments.
